words.headline: Wednesday Bundles Up: No-Heat Calls Hit 2,611, Two and a Half Times Usual
words.blurb: With the low at 32 degrees, no-heat calls jumped to 2,611 against a typical 1,048, enough to edge out parking as the top request. Whole-building outages led the chill with 1,199 reports.

boroughs.Bronx: No heat led with 909 calls, ahead of 627 home repairs.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled with 1,133 calls, with no heat close behind at 755.
boroughs.Manhattan: No heat topped the list at 527, followed by 440 home repairs.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars led with 810 calls, nearly double the 390 no-heat reports.
boroughs.Staten Island: Street fixes came out on top with 70 calls, edging parking wars at 57.
